title: internal/runstate maintenance fixture test fails on this host at the base commit
body: make test fails on exactly one test, TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo (internal/runstate), with 'a plain `git fetch` in the armed repository started no maintenance; this fixture proves nothing'. I reproduced it at the base commit 074f0861 with this tick's changes stashed — identical failure — so it is host/git-version dependent and pre-existing, not a regression from dl8. Every other Go package is green.
